DiagnosticLevel.description: Payload size for diagnostics (independent of structural `detailLevel`).

oneOf.description: Plus raw traceback / full TD dumps.

FormatMode.description: Locals capture mode for execute_python exception reports.

OpPath.description: Operator path string passed to TD for resolution via `td.op()`.

Pid.description: OS process id — sole address for tools and queues.

contextPath.description: Optional context path (exposed to script as helper; not enforced).

diagnosticLevel.description:
Diagnostic payload size (`summary` omits raw traceback).
Default for this tool is `detailed` (other tools keep global summary default).

formatMode.description: Exception report locals mode (`debug` attaches capped frame locals).

includeLogs.description: When true (default), capture stdout/stderr during exec and return as `logs`.
